name: ROOT∞REXX
source:
The rock band "REXX's" debut single was an explosive hit.

Not allowed to show their faces in public and do live shows, the band members are represented by mascots of themselves in promotional videos. Even so, they grew popular through word-of-mouth, and eventually garnered attention from all over the world.

However, without ever releasing a second single, they announced that they would go on an indefinite hiatus. A reason was never provided for this and caused a lot of confusion. Despite this, their debut single still sold well, and they gained more and more fans each day. Before they knew it, industry insiders started to call them the "legendary" band.

About a year later, the protagonist (Mochizuki Kazune), becomes fascinated by REXX's music. She finds a demo CD at the school she transferred to. To her surprise, the demo CD contains an unreleased and unannounced REXX song! On top of that, she meets five high school students who introduce themselves as REXX's members.

Upon hearing that the guys no longer intend to perform, Kazune declares, "I'll do anything to revive REXX!".

As the past entangles and causes discord, will REXX ever come back?
translation:
摇滚乐队“REXX”的首张单曲引起了爆炸性的轰动。

乐队成员不允许在公共场合露面和进行现场表演，他们在宣传视频中以自己的吉祥物为代表。即便如此，它们还是通过口耳相传而流行起来，并最终引起了世界各地的关注。

然而，在没有发行第二张单曲的情况下，他们宣布他们将无限期中断。从未提供过原因，并造成了很多混乱。尽管如此，他们的首张单曲仍然卖得很好，并且每天都获得了越来越多的粉丝。不知不觉间，业内人士开始称他们为“传奇”乐队。

大约一年后，主角（望月和音饰）迷上了REXX的音乐。她在转学到的学校找到了一张演示CD。令她惊讶的是，演示CD包含一首未发行且未宣布的REXX歌曲！最重要的是，她遇到了五名高中生，他们自称是REXX的成员。

当听到这些人不再打算表演时，和音宣称：“我会尽一切努力来复活REXX！”。

随着过去的纠缠和不和，REXX还会回来吗？
